text: A flat of three rooms under one roof. A long hall along the south side with the front door in the south wall and a small sculpture on a plinth in the middle. Two doorways lead north from the hall: the western one into a gallery with three pictures on its north wall and one on the wall it shares with the studio; the eastern one into a studio with a desk against the north wall and a wardrobe in the north-east corner. A doorway in the wall between them joins the gallery and the studio. The tour goes hall, gallery, studio, and the camera flies through the doorways, never through a wall.
